generate_graph: generate a navigable graph from points using a habitat sim pathfinder
adjust_graph: adjust a graph by removing small disconnected subgraphs with fewer than 10 nodes
visualize: visualize points and graph connections as scatter plots with optional node indices
build_matterport3d_metadata: build Matterport3D navigation graphs for all scenes with visualization and serialization
review_generate_graph: review the generate_graph function that creates edges based on geodesic distance constraints
